card.name: Small words before place names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, in, of, from, a comma) right before a place name, mostly in history or travel prose about voyages, wars and treaties. The next word is expected to be a place such as South Seas, Honolulu, Tripoli or New York.

modes.label: Article before a place
modes.description: The word "the" just before a region or state name.
modes.example: Omoo, A Narrative of Adventures in<< the>> South Seas, is a great one!

modes.label: Preposition before a place
modes.description: In, of or from linking an event, voyage or treaty to a location.
modes.example: the American squadron instituted a loose blockade<< of>> Tripoli.

modes.label: Comma or list link
modes.description: A comma or "and" in a list or aside, where a place or name comes next.
modes.example: Asiatic and Egyptian Theatres comprises Egypt, Tripoli,<< the>> Sudan, Asia Minor

card.writes: No clear meaning from the promoted tokens; it suppresses electricity-related words, so it seems to steer toward place names instead.
card.plain: It marks little linking words in history text just before the name of a place is expected.
